steps.say: Click the centre point to place your first stone. From there you can grow in every direction.
Your opponent has four in a row, with one end already blocked. Block the other end now.
steps.tip: Their line runs along row 8. Find its open end.

steps.say: Five in a row wins. You have four across. Add the fifth.
steps.tip: Either end of your line works.

steps.say: Diagonals count too. You have four on a diagonal. Finish it.
steps.tip: Follow the slant one more step either way.
